about_the_game:
IMPORTANT NOTE: The demo serves as the free prologue to ENTWINE, taking place directly before the events of the main game. It does not contain any direct content from the full game

Enter the terrifying and gripping prologue to ENTWINE: Play as Ethan Miller, an online urban explorer who goes missing after investigating the Anderson Estate.

Solve various puzzles, navigate through the countless layers of the Anderson Estate. Slowly uncover the terrifying story behind Ethan Miller before being hunted down by the puppet himself.

FEATURES

  • 45 minutes to an hour playtime.

  • Breathtaking visuals.

  • High-quality, binaural sound powered by Steam Audio.

  • A terrifyingly heavy and fresh take on psychological horror.

  • Pure isolation - no distracting NPCS or gimmicks. Just you and it.

  • Heavy focus on narrative.

  • Challenging and intricate puzzles - Inspired by the likes of Silent Hill

  • Native controller / gamepad support.

content_descriptors.notes: A few corpses and a bit of blood/gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or New-Gen i3 or the AMD equivalent.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or the AMD equivalent.
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Have one.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or New-Gen i3 or the AMD equivalent.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or the AMD equivalent.
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Have one.

short_description: Experience the terrifying prologue to ENTWINE, a first person psychological horror game. Play as Ethan Miller in a horrific hand-crafted singleplayer adventure.
